description:
A new beginning with you, on this stage!

A dream live performance by the top runners of the male idol world who competed for "BLACK or WHITE LIVE SHOWDOWN" will be held in May! IDOLiSH7, TRIGGER, Re:vale, and ŹOOĻ, 4 groups with various charms, will meet in one place, and the magnificent live entertainment will begin!

Music will connect the times and people's feelings.Thus, I hope that this stage will be loved beyond time.

(Source: Official IDOLiSH7 LIVE 4bit - BEYOND THE PERiOD site, translated)
